summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor (buffers only when is_terminal, returns bool); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking #2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests, Black, and mypy were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Choice to check: OSC number 0 was used since the spec gave no number. Nothing was committed.
